title: GATE started by Sidney Marland in 1972, possibly as a funnel

tellings.quote: I think the gate program was started by Sydney Marland in 1972

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he thinks GATE, an American school programme for gifted and talented children, was started in 1972 by an official named Sidney Marland. In an episode where a guest says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, Michels raises the idea that GATE may have worked as a funnel, a way to spot and steer bright children. If so, it would mean an ordinary school programme fed young people into hidden projects.
